meaning: Etymology not explained, probably is-, from Greek ísos “equal”, + istius, from histíon “sail” (i.e. dorsal fin), for the two similarly shaped and sized dorsal fins Gill used to diagnose the genus
description: Two living species of small oceanic sharks, the cookiecutter and the largetooth cookiecutter, with suction-cup lips and saw-like lower teeth for biting plugs of flesh from larger animals.
